judgment.quote_A: To ensure we meet our project timeline, I kindly request that you send the revised table by this coming Thursday at 3 PM.
judgment.quote_B: If there is any possibility that this deadline may not be met, I would greatly appreciate an update today.
judgment.reason: Answer B meets the 80-word limit (73 words) and faithfully preserves the deadline, the request, and the urgency ('update today' if the deadline cannot be met). Answer A exceeds the word limit (82 words), adds an invented justification ('To ensure we meet our project timeline'), and weakens the conditional request by replacing 'Tell me today if that is impossible' with 'let me know at your earliest convenience'.
